patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout combining oversized typography with a dynamic, collage-like collection of small, diverse images.
Impactful, extra-large sans-serif headings are used for primary messaging, creating strong visual hierarchy against smaller, legible body text.
A high-contrast palette of dark text on predominantly white or very light off-white backgrounds, with black used for primary call-to-action buttons.
The hero section features a fixed, subtly textured background that creates a parallax effect, while a collection of small images within the hero subtly slides horizontally as the user scrolls down.
Sections throughout the page reveal themselves with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The primary navigation bar shrinks in height and gains a subtle shadow, becoming sticky to the top of the viewport after initial scroll.
Content sections frequently use alternating background colors (white and a very light beige) to visually separate distinct blocks of information.

technique_notes: A sticky header is implemented that transforms its height and adds a subtle shadow effect upon scroll, remaining fixed at the top of the viewport.
Scroll-triggered animations, likely using CSS keyframes, are used to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the user's view.

The hero section employs a fixed background image with a subtle texture to create a parallax-like depth effect, while a collection of small, diverse images within the foreground of the hero section are animated to slide horizontally using CSS keyframes as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, impactful headings (hero ~4-5x body) with clear hierarchy and smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, creating a clean, open feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dynamic, collage-like hero section featuring a collection of small, diverse images that subtly animate horizontally upon scroll, combined with oversized, bold typography and a fixed, textured background, creates a sophisticated yet artistic first impression that avoids generic corporate aesthetics.
